questions.question: Under God's law, where did the priest go to examine a person whose skin disease had healed?
When a person with a skin disease was cleansed, what happened to the live bird dipped in the other bird's blood?

answers.text: It was released into the open field
It was offered up on the altar
It was given to the priest's family

questions.question: Under God's law for mildew in a house, what was the owner to do when mildew appeared?

answers.text: Move his family out for good

questions.question: God gave Moses a law about skin diseases, mildew, and any swelling, rash or spot. What was it for?

answers.text: To tell when something is clean or unclean
To decide who can serve as a priest
To set the days for the yearly feasts
